tab12_redirects.source: Daily log T0-a / A-63: the sitemap generator omits /products/ and freezes lastmod. Fix the generator and add the CI guard (T0-c) in the same deploy, or these pages can drop out of the sitemap the way the product estate did.

Requesting is a nudge, not a fix: ~10 requests a day, only for pages that are live, READY, in the sitemap and linked from an indexed page. The 53 flange product pages in the daily log's queue go first - they are the bigger lead lever (A-64).

tab12_redirects.target: One <link rel="canonical"> per page: absolute, https, no www, slash form, self-referencing.
The no-slash URL must redirect (C-01). A 200 plus a canonical - today's behaviour (daily log A-48) - is not enough: Google keeps choosing the linked form.
index, follow on all 9 pages (or no tag). /thank-you/ = noindex, follow.
Must not block /market-area/ or any city URL; must answer 200 (or 404) fast. Decide deliberately which AI crawlers to allow (C-00).
Answer 301 to the target - not 200, 404 or 410.
One language (en-IN): no hreflang needed. Keep <html lang="en-IN">.
?form=, ?city= and utm_ URLs are never linked internally; the canonical handles stray copies.
